en: The Second Part of the Analysis of the Monks' Rules (Bhikkhuvibhaṅga)
Regarding offenses conditioned by engaging in sexual intercourse, to which of the four legal issues (adhikaraṇa) do they belong?
Offenses conditioned by engaging in sexual intercourse belong to the legal issue of offenses (āpattādhikaraṇa). … [and so forth] …
In relation to disrespect, what kind of legal issue among the four legal issues is the offense committed by discharging feces, urine, or spittle into water?
In relation to disrespect, the offense committed by discharging feces, urine, or spittle into water is, among the four legal issues, a legal issue arising from an offense (*āpattādhikaraṇa*).
The sixth section on legal issues is concluded.
